name: P2P Stream
description: Stream torrents straight into Jellyfin. Built-in torrent sources (no extra software), TMDB catalogs as libraries, search for any movie or show from the Jellyfin search bar, and Burst-style quality filters.

versions.changelog:
What's new
- Subtitles when a release has none. With a Jellyfin subtitle plugin such as OpenSubtitles installed, a subtitle in your language is fetched when you play a release that has none. Only for what you play, so a free account's daily limit goes a long way.
- A Subtitles box on every version. Downloaded subtitles and your own subtitle files appear whichever version you pick.
- Your pick lasts until you finish. A version you choose keeps playing until you've watched the title to the end; then Auto goes back to the best match. Meanwhile Auto says "your pick".
- A tidier settings page. Nine tabs, one per job (Status, Catalogs, Search, Sources, Quality, Playback, Network, Storage, Accounts), cards in two fixed columns, and short help text with a "more" link.
- Disk space at a glance. Status and Storage show how much of the disk is used and how much is left.
- Search libraries clean themselves up. Titles a search added that nobody played are removed after the number of days you set, or straight away with Clean up now.

Better behaviour
- Only people's searches add titles; scripts and request tools using an API key no longer do.
- Releases from a slow source are added to the title's list when they arrive, instead of being dropped.
- Auto and the "Best 4K / 1080p" entries show the full release name.
- Source rows start collapsed; "change address" opens the address box.

What's new
- Playing away from home just works. Stream links use the address each device reached Jellyfin by, so a phone outside your network plays through your reverse proxy without any setting.
- Version choices are per person. A version you pick is remembered for you; everyone else keeps getting the best match.
- Hide the search libraries from the home screen while keeping their titles in Jellyfin search (Libraries tab).

Faster and more reliable
- First plays start sooner: searches no longer wait for a site that isn't answering (it's skipped for a few minutes), and peers are connected faster.
- Each torrent downloads into its own folder.
- Season packs play the right episode.
- Catalogs that share a folder no longer remove each other's titles, and catalog collections only change collections the plugin made.
- Making a new stream token updates every link in about a minute instead of up to an hour.

Security
- Playback and the Version menu respect each user's library access.
- Stream links shown to apps no longer contain the stream token. New tokens are made on the server, with an option to stop old links at once.
- Links from search results and torrents can't reach devices on your home network, and .torrent downloads are size-limited.
- Searches set to go through the proxy never fall back to a direct connection.

Plus smaller fixes for subtitle files, Trakt sign-in, the torrent limit, cache sizes, log messages and setting descriptions.

Pre-loads the next episode, playback safety fixes for season packs and subtitle files, subtitles for torrents you add, Trakt without a Client Secret, and removing unused catalog folders. See the release notes.
First public release: on-demand torrent streaming with built-in sources, catalogs, Version menu, fast starts, release subtitles, VPN privacy and port forwarding. See the release notes.
